answers.core: I can't really think of a case where you wouldn't want an animation to play at that speed in the tree if you did define it. It kind of seems like an oversight. I think that should be the default behavior and if you need to make it play at a speed other than the animation playback speed, _then_ you can make it a blend node and change the timescale.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by using a BlendTree for every animation and setting the playback speed there, but this is cumbersome, and causes rework and duplication of data. I'm not sure how to do this via script, but it seems like the implementation would be complicated and difficult to manage.

title: Make AnimationStateMachine respect animations' Playback Speed property
